papers.title: Logic Hijacking of RAG: Single-Document Poisoning via Local Optimization
papers.summary: Proposes MONOLOGUE, a black-box single-document poisoning attack on RAG that concedes the ground truth as a historical baseline and then presents the counterfactual as a dated record correction, avoiding the explicit contradictions aligned LLMs reject. Payloads are refined offline with gated optimization combining text-quality audits and surrogate behavioral checks, and it achieves the strongest overall efficacy across three benchmarks, three retrievers and four generators.

papers.title: Rethinking Verification in Agent Harnesses
papers.summary: Frames verification in LLM agent harnesses as test-time scaling across four layers (initial instructions, mid-turn reminders, completion gates, independent review) and compares 17 designs on seven frontier coding models using Terminal-Bench, SWE-bench Verified and the new VisualBench. Independent critic review gives the best accuracy-cost tradeoff, adding 5.9-9.5 points on Terminal-Bench and 3.9-6.6 on SWE-bench Verified.
